bio-AndyNguyen: He is our friend as well as our dedicated teacher who has used his years of experience supporting the Vietnamese community to thoroughly guide us. Without his help, we would not be able to achieve so many accomplishments for our community.
bio-DaoNguyen: As the CPO of VVF, I create strategic plans for growth. As a business analyst and professional event planner, I excel at turning ideas into well-executed initiatives that foster connection and community engagement. I believe that thoughtful planning and data-driven decision-making can make a lasting difference, especially in empowering the Vietnamese community in Vancouver.
bio-EattleNguyen: As the CMO of VVF, I am passionate about using music to connect and uplift communities. As a drummer, leading bands and performing at events brings me immense joy, but beyond that, I see music as a powerful tool to bring people together. I am dedicated to connecting the Vietnamese community world wide as well through rhythm and artistic expression, which will be able to touch people's hearts through boundaries and races.
bio-KhaiHung: I always think that life is an adventure, but it is bounded by countless logic. Therefore, I became a software developer in order to explore and create breakthrough programs. By joining VVF as a CTO, I promise to dedicate my skills by utilizing the latest technologies to enrich the Vietnamese community in Vancouver, starting with this platform. Please visit my portfolio if you want to know more about my products at: https://khaihung.dev/.
bio-LunaNguyen: I have always believed that helping others ultimately brings meaningful rewards. As the CHRO of VVF, my goal is to leverage my experience to make a positive impact on the whole community. By applying strategic planning and fostering transparent communication, I strive to ensure members’ satisfaction while aligning their efforts with VVF’s visions and missions.
bio-TrongNguyen: I love the job of helping others to relieve their pains and improve their quality of life. However, I realize that I cannot help thousands or millions of people if I keep working as current. That’s why I have been learning and working in computer science and data science to help more and more people in the world.
description-AndyNguyen: A professional tennis instructor, director of a healthcare-related IT company, and a dedicated Vietnamese community supporter
description-DaoNguyen: A market researcher and professional event planner
description-EattleNguyen: A drummer, songwriter, pianist and guitarist.
description-KhaiHung: A software developer, a 2D/3D designer, a guitarist and an explorer
description-LunaNguyen: Upcoming professional in Human Resource management, currently a CPHR Candidate, an active member of CPHR BC & Yukon, a communicator and traveller – have been flying to more than 50 countries and 6 continents of the world ( Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Europe, and Oceania).
description-TrongNguyen: A doctor, a guitarist, a data analyst, a programmer and a life-time learner.
description-vision-aboutUs: We are the Viet Vibe Foundation, a vibrant non-profit organization dedicated to fostering vibrancy, creativity, and building connections within the Vietnamese community in Vancouver. With the enthusiasm and passion of our members, we aim to bring people together through the universal languages of sports, music, and other activities.
header-allmembers: And all of our other members, whether active or not, will always be a precious part of our VVF family:
musicDescription-aboutUs: With professional performers who have experience in a wide range of instruments and skills (guitar, piano, drum, dance, etc.), our music lessons and workshops offer participants the opportunity to learn, grow, and connect with the art of music in a connecting and inspiring environment.
sportDescription-aboutUs: From exciting competitions to hands-on skill-building sessions, we invite everyone to join in - regardless of age or experience. Have fun, improve your skills, connect with others, and enjoy being part of a welcoming, vibrant, and inclusive community of sports lovers.
volunteerDescription-aboutUs: We believe everyone deserves the chance to participate in activities and events that help them grow and build strong connections. We warmly welcome new members to join us and make meaningful contributions to the Vietnamese as well as all our global friends in Vancouver.
